sections.title: Technologies We Use to Build AI Assistants

items.a:
An AI assistant is software that helps people handle daily work faster and with less effort. It can look up data, answer questions, write short notes, or help you find things inside your business tools.

Unlike old automation tools, it learns from how you use it. Every week it becomes a bit smarter and starts feeling more like a real helper than a program.

items.q: How long does it take to build a custom AI assistant?
items.a:
It usually depends on what you want the assistant to do. A simple version can be built within a few weeks, while more advanced ones with deep integrations may take a few months.The cost of developing custom software depends on multiple factors, including project complexity, required features, technology stack, compliance requirements (if applicable), and team size.

Most time goes into discovery and design. Once everything is clear, the rest of the development usually moves quite quickly.

items.q: How much does custom AI assistant development cost?
items.a:
There is no fixed price because every project is different. The cost changes depending on features, data work, and integrations.

Small assistants are more affordable, while large business systems need a bigger budget. In most cases, the investment pays off quickly as teams save hours every week and focus on things that really move the business forward.

items.q: Where can AI assistants be used?
items.a: They can be used almost anywhere — in support, logistics, finance, or healthcare. Many teams use them to process data, answer client questions, or automate long manual routines. They fit naturally into different environments and make existing workflows smoother without big changes.

items.q: What is the difference between an AI assistant and an AI agent?
items.a:
An assistant helps users by replying, searching, or guiding them through tasks. An agent can also act on its own, like sending data or managing a workflow once you set the goal.

You can think of the assistant as a colleague who helps you stay on track, while the agent works more independently and handles the routine itself.

items.q: Can AI assistants integrate with existing systems?
items.a: Yes, they can connect with tools your team already uses — CRM, ERP, or any cloud platform. It means you don’t need to change your setup. Everything runs securely, with access control and encryption, so your information stays safe while your work becomes faster and more coordinated.
